answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if it is caught coordinating fake identities to claim rewards. To earn the bond back, an identity must complete useful work across a waiting period and pass random audits against duplicate accounts. A sybil operator must therefore lock up capital for every persona, pay the cost of sustained activity, and risk losing all the bonds when linked accounts are exposed. Longer delays raise the horizon of that expense; a vine of copied profiles is no shortcut, and a lotus-like cluster still has to pay per identity.
